IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: PRIVATE SCHOOL THAT PROMISES TO PRACTICE RESPECT, EMBRACES DIVERSITY, AND INSPIRE PASSION TO LEARN.
IRS990.MissionDesc: A PRIVATE SCHOOL THAT CULTIVATES AND CELEBRATES THE INTELLECTUAL, IMAGINATIVE, AND HUMANITARIAN PROMISE OF EACH STUDENT IN A COMMUNITY THAT PRACTICES MUTUAL RESPECT, EMBRACES DIVERSITY, AND INSPIRES PASSION FOR LEARNING.
IRS990.Desc: THE SAN FRANCISCO SCHOOL CULTIVATES AND CELEBRATES THE INTELLECTUAL, IMAGINATIVE, AND HUMANITARIAN PROMISE OF EACH STUDENT IN A COMMUNITY THAT PRACTICES MUTUAL RESPECT, EMBRACES DIVERSITY, AND INSPIRES A PASSION FOR LEARNING.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE SCHOOL IS A QUALIFIED ORGANIZATION EXEMPT FROM FEDERAL INCOME AND CALIFORNIA FRANCHISE TAXES UNDER THE PROVISIONS OF SECTIONS 501(C)(3) OF THE INTERNAL REVENUE CODE AND 23701D OF THE CALIFORNIA REVENUE AND TAXATION CODE, RESPECTIVELY. THE SCHOOL HAS EVALUATED ITS CURRENT TAX POSITIONS AND HAS CONCLUDED THAT AS OF JUNE 30, 2025, THE SCHOOL DOES NOT HAVE ANY SIGNIFICANT UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS FOR WHICH A RESERVE WOULD BE NECESSARY.
THE NONDISCRIMINATORY POLICY IS POSTED ON THE HOME PAGE OF THE SCHOOL'S WEBSITE, AND IS ALSO INCLUDED IN BROCHURES.

THE SAN FRANCISCO SCHOOL SUBSCRIBES TO THE CLARITY FINANCIAL INC. AFTER FAMILIES SUBMIT DETAILED FINANCIAL INFORMATION, CLARITY USES A PROPRIETARY METHODOLOGY TO RECOMMEND AN AMOUNT THAT EACH FAMILY CAN AFFORD FOR EDUCATIONAL EXPENSES. THE SCHOOL'S TUITION ASSISTANCE COMMITTEE, CONSISTING OF THE HEAD OF SCHOOL, CFOO, AND ADMISSIONS DIRECTOR, USES THIS FIGURE AS THE BASIS FOR DETERMINING THE FINANCIAL AWARD CALCULATION.
THE HEAD OF SCHOOL RECEIVED A HOUSING ALLOWANCE, WHICH WAS INCLUDED IN REPORTABLE COMPENSATION ON SCHEDULE J, PART II, COLUMN B(III).

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: PART I, LINE A, COLUMN F:
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: ON DECEMBER 1, 2010, THE SAN FRANCISCO SCHOOL ENTERED INTO A LOAN AGREEMENT WITH FIRST REPUBLIC BANK AND CALIFORNIA ENTERPRISE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY FOR A TAX-EXEMPT BANK LOAN OF $4.5MILLION TO FINANCE THE SCHOOL'S BUILDING CONSTRUCTION PROJECT. THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE ISSUE PRICE AND THE TOTAL PROCEEDS OF ISSUE IS THE ORIGINAL DISCOUNT OF $45,000 WHICH HAS BEEN SET TO AMORTIZE OVER THE LIFE OF THE LOAN. IN FISCAL YEAR 2025, $179,836 OF PRINCIPAL WAS PAID. SINCE INCEPTION, $1,534,616 HAS BEEN PAID.
THIS NUMBER REPRESENTS THE NUMBER OF CONTRIBUTIONS, NOT THE NUMBER OF ITEMS CONTRIBUTED.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 6
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: ALL PARENTS OF CHILDREN ATTENDING THE SAN FRANCISCO SCHOOL ARE CONSIDERED MEMBERS OF THE ORGANIZATION.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 7A
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: FAMILY MEMBERS OF THE CORPORATION ELECT THE FIFTEEN (15) CLASS A TRUSTEE SEATS FOR A THREE YEAR TERM. THE NOMINATING COMMITTEE OF THE BOARD DESIGNATES THREE (3) STAFF MEMBERS FOR THE CLASS B TRUSTEE SEATS, AND ONE ADDITIONAL CLASS B TRUSTEE SEAT IS THE HEAD OF SCHOOL. THE BOARD ELECTS SIX (6) CLASS C TRUSTEE SEATS FOR THE THREE YEAR TERM.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 7B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: MEMBERS MUST VOTE TO APPROVE (1) DISPOSITION OF ALL OR SUBSTANTIALLY ALL OF THE ASSETS OF THE CORPORATION, (2) A MERGER OR DISSOLUTION OF THE CORPORATION, AND (3) ANY AMENDMENT TO THE BYLAWS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE TAX FORM 990 IS DRAFTED BY SAN FRANCISCO SCHOOL'S CONTROLLER IN COLLABORATION WITH THE SCHOOL'S ACCOUNTING FIRM. THE COMPLETED FORM 990 IS REVIEWED BY THE CHIEF FINANCIAL AND OPERATIONAL OFFICER, HEAD OF SCHOOL, CHAIR OF FINANCE COMMITTEE AND BOARD CHAIR. A COPY OF THE FORM 990 EXCLUDING SCHEDULE B IS PROVIDED TO CLASS A AND CLASS C TRUSTEES PRIOR TO THE FILING.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE SAN FRANCISCO SCHOOL'S BOARD OF TRUSTEES ENFORCES THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY IN THE FOLLOWING MANNER: (1) BOARD MEMBERS ANNUALLY REVIEW CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY AND FILL OUT CONFLICT OF INTEREST QUESTIONNAIRES (2) TRAIN NEW TRUSTEES ON CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY (3) START EVERY BOARD MEETING WITH REVIEW OF AGENDA AND CONFLICT CHECK (4) REVIEW CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY AND BY-LAWS REGULARLY FOR CONFLICT ISSUES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: COMPENSATION TO THE HEAD OF SCHOOL AND OTHER KEY MANAGEMENT EMPLOYEES WAS BENCHMARKED TO OTHER K-8 INDEPENDENT SCHOOLS OF SIMILAR SIZE IN THE SAN FRANCISCO BAY AREA. DATA WAS USED FROM THREE DIFFERENT SOURCES, 1) FEDERAL FORM 990, 2) STATISTICS FROM NAIS (NATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF INDEPENDENT SCHOOLS) AND 3) STATISTICS FROM CAL-ISBOA (CALIFORNIA INDEPENDENT SCHOOLS BUSINESS OFFICERS ASSOCIATION). THE CLASS A AND CLASS C TRUSTEES APPROVE THE CONTRACT FOR THE HEAD OF SCHOOL. ALL OTHER HIGHER LEVEL EMPLOYEE COMPENSATION IS APPROVED BY THE HEAD OF SCHOOL, WITH A REVIEW ANNUALLY BY A COMPENSATION COMMITTEE.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: GOVERNING DOCUMENTS, FINANCIAL STATEMENTS, AND CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY ARE ALL MADE AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC UPON REQUEST ARE IMMEDIATELY SUPPLIED FOR THE SAME PERIOD OF TIME SET FORTH IN SEC. 6104(D).
